title: Tennessee inmate gets ‘life-saving medical care’ after surviving botched execution
summary: Christa Pike was critically ill and receiving “life-saving medical care” in a Nashville hospital today hours after she survived two attempts by Tennessee to execute her with lethal injections, her lawyers said, renewing scrutiny of capital punishment in the United States.
author: Reuters
